title: Known Cases of Iitaka Subadditivity
exact_target:
For a surjective morphism $f:X\to Y$ of smooth projective varieties over a field of characteristic zero, with connected fibers and general fiber $F$, must the Kodaira dimensions satisfy
\[\kappa(X)\geq\kappa(Y)+\kappa(F)?\]
The Kodaira dimension measures the asymptotic growth of pluricanonical sections; the question is ordinary Iitaka subadditivity.
